newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian O/N rates ease to end at 20.625 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian O/N rates ease to end at 20.625 percent.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed lower after routine trade and abundant money supply, dealers said on Tuesday.
Overnight rates finished at 20.625 percent, compared with Monday's close of 21 percent.
"The rates are likely to hover around this level for the next few days," said Ildiko Meszaros of Hanwha Bank.
Hungary's overnight rates tend to move around the central bank's benchmark one-week reverse repo rate, currently at 20.75 percent.
